static_controls.candidate: Node scrypt with encoded parameters and per-password salt; password verification uses timing-safe comparison.
Short-lived HMAC-signed access token carries subject, session and auth/authorization versions.
Opaque refresh credentials are hashed at rest; credential families/sessions support rotation, reuse detection and family revocation.
vinops_refresh cookie builder uses HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax; Secure is configuration-driven and no Domain attribute is emitted by the builder.
Refresh checks a session-bound CSRF secret and allowed Origin/Referer; bootstrap config sets exact CORS origins and allowed headers.
In-process rate-limit service is wired for login and password-reset operations.
Web API client holds access/CSRF values in memory and uses credentialed fetch for the HttpOnly refresh cookie.

required_runtime_assertions: Generic login/reset failures do not reveal account existence.
Refresh cookie, CSRF token and allowed origin are all required and rotation revokes a reused family.
Logout/session revocation invalidates protected access on the server.
Password reset increments auth/authorization versions and revokes active refresh families.
Cache-Control: no-store and production Secure/CORS configuration are observed over the running API.
No token, cookie or auth secret is emitted in logs or evidence.
known_non_proof: Unit/source inspection is not an end-to-end authentication proof.
No external identity provider, email service or production secret was selected or exercised.
The in-process rate limiter has no demonstrated multi-instance coordination.
